meta.subject: Bug fixed: between the new cta impl and ventus

en.summary: This commit fixes a real CTA launch metadata mismatch; the clearest bug is that the top-level path had wired workgroup ID into the threads-per-wavefront field.
why_it_counts: The patch changes CTA scheduler and top-level dispatch RTL, not just host software or tests.
Driving num_thread_per_wf from host_wg_id is an obvious metadata miswire with direct execution impact.
The same commit also restores parameterized wavefront slot limits so the new CTA path matches the configured machine.
disqualifiers: MemBox.scala is also touched, and that file is partly a simulation-side host request generator.
evidence: GPGPU_top.scala changes cta_sche.io.host_wg_new.bits.num_thread_per_wf from io.host2CTA.bits.host_wg_id to io.host2CTA.bits.host_wf_size.
cta_scheduler.scala changes NUM_WF_SLOT from 32 back to parameters.num_warp and NUM_WF_MAX from 32 to parameters.num_warp_in_a_block.
MemBox.scala changes generated host_wg_id from a shifted blockID encoding to plain blockID.U.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A launch or dispatch packet carries execution-shape metadata such as threads per wavefront. If that field is accidentally driven from an unrelated identifier field, the compute core receives structurally valid but semantically wrong launch information. That can distort execution masks, wavefront decomposition, or downstream resource accounting even though the interface itself still handshakes correctly.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: launch metadata routing between front-end and CTA scheduler
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A workgroup launch occurs where the workgroup ID differs from the intended threads-per-wavefront value.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Feed the threads-per-wavefront field from a workgroup identifier or other unrelated metadata field.
portability_notes: This applies to any GPU or many-threaded dispatch path that carries wavefront, warp, or sub-group shape information.
The fault is most portable when injected at a bundle or packet boundary rather than deep inside allocator state.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the dispatch bundle that carries workgroup metadata from the front-end or host path into the CTA scheduler or CU interface.
Reconnect the field describing threads per wavefront so it comes from a workgroup ID or other unrelated identifier field.
Keep the rest of the dispatch packet unchanged so the failure is isolated to metadata misrouting rather than packet formatting.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit rewires num_thread_per_wf to host_wf_size instead of host_wg_id and restores parameterized CTA wavefront limits.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In GPGPU_top.scala, cta_sche.io.host_wg_new.bits.num_thread_per_wf changed from io.host2CTA.bits.host_wg_id to io.host2CTA.bits.host_wf_size.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The scheduler or CU interprets the launch with the wrong wavefront size, which can produce malformed execution masks, incorrect resource allocation, or broken CTA dispatch behavior.
evidence_for_injection: The top-level wiring fix is explicit and source-to-source obvious.
The destination field directly affects execution geometry and is consumed by the CTA scheduler/CU path.
Parameter-limit fixes in cta_scheduler.scala support the same conclusion that the bug is in launch metadata compatibility.
notes: The top-level metadata swap is the best standalone reinjection target from this commit.
MemBox.scala is useful as supporting context but is not required for a portable fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了真实的 CTA 启动元数据不匹配；其中最清晰的缺陷是：顶层路径把 workgroup ID 错接到了每个 wavefront 的线程数字段上。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CTA scheduler 和顶层派发 RTL，而不是单纯的 host 软件或测试。
把 num_thread_per_wf 接到 host_wg_id 是明显的元数据错连，会直接影响执行行为。
同一提交还恢复了参数化的 wavefront 数量上限，使新 CTA 路径与机器配置一致。
disqualifiers: MemBox.scala 也被修改了，而该文件部分属于仿真侧的 host 请求生成逻辑。
evidence: GPGPU_top.scala 把 cta_sche.io.host_wg_new.bits.num_thread_per_wf 从 io.host2CTA.bits.host_wg_id 改成了 io.host2CTA.bits.host_wf_size。
cta_scheduler.scala 把 NUM_WF_SLOT 从 32 改回 parameters.num_warp，并把 NUM_WF_MAX 从 32 改为 parameters.num_warp_in_a_block。
MemBox.scala 把生成的 host_wg_id 从带移位的 blockID 编码改成了 plain blockID.U。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 启动或派发数据包会携带执行形状元数据，例如每个 wavefront 的线程数。如果这个字段被错误地接到无关的标识字段上，计算核心虽然仍能收到结构合法的数据包，但其语义已经错误。这样会扭曲执行掩码、wavefront 拆分方式，或者后续资源计数，即使接口握手本身仍然看起来正常。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: front-end 到 CTA scheduler 的启动元数据连线
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 发生 workgroup 派发，并且 workgroup ID 与预期的每 wavefront 线程数不同。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 threads-per-wavefront 字段来自 workgroup 标识或其他无关元数据字段。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何携带 wavefront、warp 或 sub-group 执行形状信息的 GPU/多线程派发路径。
最可移植的做法是在 bundle/packet 边界注入，而不是深入 allocator 内部状态。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到从前端或 host 路径进入 CTA scheduler 或 CU interface 的 workgroup 派发 bundle。
把表示每个 wavefront 线程数的字段重新连接到 workgroup ID 或其他无关标识字段上。
保持其余派发字段不变，使故障表现为元数据错连，而不是整体包格式错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: host 到 CTA 的 num_thread_per_wf 元数据连线
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 num_thread_per_wf 从 host_wg_id 改接为 host_wf_size，并恢复了参数化的 CTA wavefront 上限。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 GPGPU_top.scala 中，cta_sche.io.host_wg_new.bits.num_thread_per_wf 从 io.host2CTA.bits.host_wg_id 改成了 io.host2CTA.bits.host_wf_size。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: scheduler 或 CU 会用错误的 wavefront 大小解释该次启动，从而导致执行掩码异常、资源分配错误，或 CTA 派发行为损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 顶层连线修复是显式的，源字段和目标字段都非常清楚。
目标字段直接影响执行几何信息，并由 CTA scheduler/CU 路径消费。
cta_scheduler.scala 中的参数上限修复进一步说明问题属于启动元数据兼容性错误。
notes: 这个顶层字段错连是该提交中最好的单点回注目标。
MemBox.scala 可以作为辅助上下文，但不是构造可移植故障所必需的部分。
